body.name: Ordinary full-kernel design embedding \(\iota\) on \(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\)
body.construction:
For \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{ord}}=(G,S_0,(\kappa_v)_{v\in V})\in\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\), use the all-cells Layer-2.5 translation of \(Q[S_0]\) and let \(G^{+}\) retain the ordinary node mechanisms.  The catalogue has one mandatory fresh-unit SELECT \(s\) with \(c(s)=0\); for every \(v\in V\), one RAND action \(r_v\), independently uniform on \(\mathfrak X_v\), affecting exactly the ordinary children of \(v\), with \(c(r_v)=\kappa_v\); and one zero-cost READ action \(\rho_v\) with endpoint \(v\).  SELECT precedes every other action, the remaining actions follow canonical causal order, and there are no conflicts or CTF-RAND actions.  For \(B\subseteq V\), put
\[
 S_B=\{s\}\cup\{r_v:v\in B\}\cup\{\rho_v:v\in V\}.
\]
Conditioning the independent RAND labels at \(b\in\mathfrak X_B\) gives the ordinary source \(P_b(V\setminus B)\), with label probability \(\prod_{v\in B}|\mathfrak X_v|^{-1}>0\) and protocol cost \(\sum_{v\in B}\kappa_v\).  The source oracle returns a symbolic handle for each complete ordinary experimental law and its exact support table.  The structural reduction treats this oracle as an input oracle; its response bits are charged separately to \(N_{\mathcal O}\) and are not expanded into the structural reduction string.
